name: Garrigàs (Spain)
description: Dark green field charged at the centre with a yellow branch of kermes oak with two leaves and three acorns.
history: The flag was approved by the municipal council on 7 February 2002 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3631 of 8 May 2002; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, dark green, with a yellow branch of kermes oak with a leaf on each side pointing to the upper edge and three acorns.

features.role: branch of kermes oak (garric) with two leaves and three acorns
